title: Minimum Amount Of Time To Collect Garbage
statement:
There are houses in order, with garbage types `M`, `P`, and `G`. Each truck starts at house 0, collects only its own type, and spends one minute per piece. `travel[i]` is the time to move from house `i` to `i + 1`. Return the total time for all three trucks to collect every piece and travel as far as needed.

## Examples

```text
Input: garbage = ["G", "P", "GP", "GG"], travel = [2, 4, 3]
Output: 21
```

```text
Input: garbage = ["MMM", "PGM", "GP"], travel = [3, 10]
Output: 37
```

## Constraints

- `2 <= garbage.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= garbage[i].length <= 10`
- Each garbage character is `M`, `P`, or `G`.
- `travel.length == garbage.length - 1`
- `1 <= travel[i] <= 100`
